name: Fiorenzato Pietro (B-Modal burrs)
details: Vertical hand grinder with 58 mm flat burrs and a stepless ring nut numbered 0–10. These are the B-Modal burrs (the finer set, espresso to filter).

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–0.6, espresso 0.2–2.8, moka pot 2.6–6.5, AeroPress 2.0–10.0, V60 3.1–7.0, filter coffee machine 1.8–9.7, French press 7.0–10.0, cold brew 8.4–10.0. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Fiorenzato's own ring-nut chart (in the Pietro manual) shows these burrs covering ibrik to cold brew.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
